title: Effect of Aging Duration on the Microstructure and Corrosion Characteristics of 17-4 PH Stainless Steel
selection: New paper not in operating training or expanded 385-row corpus; tabulated bulk composition, aging temperature/time, and Tafel means.
primary_conditions: All four reported ST+aging conditions: 480 C, 1/4/8/32 h
secondary: As-received control, no thermal pair; never fabricate 0 C/0 min
missing_policy: Unreported N, RE, pH, test temperature, exposure left missing. Apply only saved training-fitted transforms.
evaluation: Retrospective external-paper evaluation, not blinded prospective experiment

primary.r2_note: Null if fewer than 2 records or constant observed values; small or narrow-range experiments give unstable R2

all_five_secondary.r2_note: Null if fewer than 2 records or constant observed values; small or narrow-range experiments give unstable R2

process_category_note: Heat history documented numerically; no asserted mapping of combined solution-plus-aging route to an existing category.
Cr_linewrap_note: Primary Table 1 text wraps 15.398 into 15.39 + 8; both numeric interpretations evaluated as sensitivity, no choice by score.
